# Essentia's voice/instrumental classifier

`voice_instrumental-audioset-yamnet-1.onnx`: the classification head of
the Music Technology Group (Universitat Pompeu Fabra) that tells music
with voice from instrumental music, over YAMNet's 1024-wide embeddings
(one row a frame; the output a softmax, instrumental then voice). From
https://essentia.upf.edu/models.html, by Pablo Alonso, 2022, with its
metadata beside.
